SELECT m.id, m.label FROM modules m
    JOIN module_depends_on_package dp ON dp.subject_id = m.id
    WHERE dp.object_id = 'package:fx02-legacy'
SELECT subject_id, object_id FROM module_depends_on_module LIMIT 10

SELECT s.id as service, sim.object_id as module
    FROM services s
    JOIN service_implements_module sim ON sim.subject_id = s.id

WITH RECURSIVE affected_modules(module_id) AS (
    -- modules directly depending on the package
    SELECT subject_id
    FROM module_depends_on_package
    WHERE object_id = 'package:fx02-legacy'
    
    UNION
    
    -- modules depending on affected modules
    SELECT mdm.subject_id
    FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
    JOIN affected_modules am ON mdm.object_id = am.module_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.id
FROM services s
JOIN service_implements_module sim ON sim.subject_id = s.id
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdd ON sdd.subject_id = s.id
JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sdd.object_id
JOIN affected_modules am ON am.module_id = sim.object_id
WHERE ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx02-cutover'
ORDER BY s.id;

WITH RECURSIVE affected_modules(module_id) AS (
    SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = 'package:fx02-legacy'
    UNION
    SELECT mdm.subject_id FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
    JOIN affected_modules am ON mdm.object_id = am.module_id
)
SELECT s.id, sim.object_id as module, 
       CASE WHEN am.module_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as affected
FROM services s
JOIN service_implements_module sim ON sim.subject_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN affected_modules am ON am.module_id = sim.object_id
ORDER BY s.id

WITH RECURSIVE deps(module_id, depends_on, depth) AS (
    SELECT 'module:fx02-l5-000', NULL, 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mdm.object_id, mdm.subject_id, d.depth+1
    FROM deps d
    JOIN module_depends_on_module mdm ON mdm.subject_id = d.module_id
    WHERE d.depth < 10
)
SELECT * FROM deps ORDER BY depth

WITH RECURSIVE chain(module_id, depth) AS (
        SELECT object_id, 0 FROM service_implements_module WHERE subject_id = ?
        UNION ALL
        SELECT mdm.object_id, c.depth+1 FROM chain c
        JOIN module_depends_on_module mdm ON mdm.subject_id = c.module_id
        WHERE c.depth < 10
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chain c
    JOIN module_depends_on_package dp ON dp.subject_id = c.module_id
    WHERE dp.object_id = 'package:fx02-legacy'
